name: Zurich Marató Barcelona

trackSource.notes: Strava route linked as "View on Strava" on the official course page on 2026-11-27, next to a PDF map named 6.5-Mapa-Circuit-ZMB26.pdf (2026). Which edition the Strava route is for could not be read; Strava requires a signed-in account to export GPX. The 2027 route came from the official Strava GPX attached to issue #94.

notes: The catalog's 2027 edition carries the 2026 route, start time and box gun times forward because the organizer had not published 2027 details. On 2026-11-27 the regulations named the 2027 race day and gave an 08:30 start (wheelchair 8:25) in an article that does not name the edition, so the start time stays unknown; no 2027 box times were published.
